text:
## Common Issues & Resolution  
| Issue | Cause | Resolution |
|-------|-------|-----------|
| KYC document expired | Customer used old ID | Request new valid document |
| Address mismatch | ID/verification address different | Explain requirement, request current address verification |
| AML screening delay | System delay or hit found | Wait for confirmation, escalate if needed |
| Form incomplete | Customer missed fields | Contact customer, request missing info |
| Slow online opening | System processing | Retry, contact support if persistent |

raw_entities.name: Account Opening Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end account opening workflow that includes KYC document verification, address verification, and AML screening. The process may encounter delays or exceptions requiring customer contact and escalation.

raw_entities.name: KYC Document Verification
raw_entities.description: Verification step where customer-provided identity documents are checked for validity and currency. Documents may be expired or invalid, requiring replacement.

raw_entities.name: Address Verification
raw_entities.description: Verification step comparing customer-provided address against identity document and verification records. Mismatches trigger customer contact and request for current address proof.
context: Explain requirement, request current address verification

raw_entities.name: AML Screening
raw_entities.description: Anti-Money Laundering screening step that may experience system delays or generate hits requiring confirmation and potential escalation.
context: Wait for confirmation, escalate if needed

raw_entities.name: Form Completion Check
raw_entities.description: Validation step ensuring all required form fields are completed by the customer. Incomplete forms trigger customer contact to obtain missing information.

raw_entities.description: Online system processing step for account opening that may experience delays requiring retry or support contact.

raw_entities.description: Support role responsible for contacting customers regarding incomplete forms, missing information, and persistent system issues.

raw_entities.description: Role responsible for escalating AML screening delays or hits that require confirmation and further investigation.

context: Wait for confirmation, escalate if needed
